cohort: 114,500 children from the Norwegian Mother and Child (MoBa) Cohort Study
finding: Development of celiac disease in children is significantly associated with sex of the child, maternal celiac disease, and type 1 diabetes but not with intrauterine growth, birth weight, or mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Celiac disease was not associated with mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Birth weight was not associated with celiac disease.
